title: Compassion Seminar
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett leads a seminar on compassion, opening with a flip-chart brainstorm of what compassion is and is not. Nomon then lays out compassion as a process: noticing suffering, feeling something, deciding to care, being willing to stay, and taking skillful action, with ways of dropping out at each step, such as denial, overwhelm, and self-protection. A Venn diagram of overlapping circles shows how much closeness is too little or too much, and compassion is split into three directions: for others, from others, and for oneself. A writing exercise follows, in which each person records a self-critical voice, thanks it for any helpful intent, and writes a kind letter to themselves as a best friend, before breaking into groups of three.
topics: the importance of mindfulness in responding to suffering
the role of rationalizations and denial in preventing compassion
the value of acknowledging the utility of a critical inner voice.
